title: Whale holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="whaleBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4aa8e0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2b6fa8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="heartGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b9d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d43a6e"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water spout -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="20" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#8fe0ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="26" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#8fe0ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="26" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#8fe0ff"/>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d="M66 66 Q82 54 88 62 Q82 68 74 70 Q86 72 90 78 Q80 80 66 74 Z" fill="#2b6fa8"/>
  <path d="M66 66 Q78 60 86 63" stroke="#4aa8e0" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

  <!-- whale body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="58" rx="32" ry="22" fill="url(#whaleBody)"/>

  <!-- belly light patch -->
  <path d="M18 66 Q42 80 66 66 Q64 78 42 80 Q20 78 18 66 Z" fill="#a8dcf5"/>

  <!-- fins -->
  <path d="M34 74 Q30 84 40 82 Q40 76 38 74 Z" fill="#1f5586"/>

  <!-- fin flipper holding heart -->
  <path d="M46 70 Q50 66 56 66 Q58 70 54 72 Q50 74 46 70 Z" fill="#1f5586"/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="52" r="4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="52" r="2" fill="#c9f0ff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M16 60 Q22 66 30 62" stroke="#a8dcf5" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- heart held -->
  <g transform="translate(56,48)">
    <path d="M10 26 C10 26 -2 16 -2 8 C-2 3 2 0 6 0 C8 0 10 2 10 4 C10 2 12 0 14 0 C18 0 22 3 22 8 C22 16 10 26 10 26 Z" fill="url(#heartGrad)"/>
    <path d="M6 6 C4 6 3 8 3 10" stroke="#ffc2d8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- little highlights -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="48" r="1.2" fill="#c9f0ff" opacity="0.9"/>
</svg>
